maxWidth.$description: Default maximum width for single-column forms. Full-width fields fill this column, not the full page.

compactMaxWidth.$description: Compact maximum width for short forms, authentication forms, cards, modals and drawers.

wideMaxWidth.$description: Wider maximum width for complex forms where the default form column is too constrained.

base.$description: Base typography for labels used by individual form controls. Form labels use body-sized text because labels are primary task content.

md.$description: Medium breakpoint typography for labels used by individual form controls.

lg.$description: Large breakpoint typography for labels used by individual form controls.

color.$description: Default text colour for form labels.

base.$description: Base breakpoint legend typography for a grouped form question that is also the page heading.

md.$description: Medium breakpoint legend typography for a grouped form question that is also the page heading.

lg.$description: Large breakpoint legend typography for a grouped form question that is also the page heading.

base.$description: Base breakpoint default legend typography for a top-level grouped form question beneath the page heading.

md.$description: Medium breakpoint default legend typography for a top-level grouped form question beneath the page heading.

lg.$description: Large breakpoint default legend typography for a top-level grouped form question beneath the page heading.

base.$description: Legend typography for a grouped form question inside a larger H2-level section.

md.$description: Medium breakpoint legend typography for a grouped form question inside a larger H2-level section.

lg.$description: Large breakpoint legend typography for a grouped form question inside a larger H2-level section.

base.$description: Legend typography for a grouped form question inside a larger H3-level subsection.

md.$description: Medium breakpoint legend typography for a grouped form question inside a larger H3-level subsection.

lg.$description: Large breakpoint legend typography for a grouped form question inside a larger H3-level subsection.

base.$description: Base breakpoint compact legend typography for dense grouped controls such as filters, cards and settings panels.

md.$description: Medium breakpoint compact legend typography for dense grouped controls such as filters, cards and settings panels.

lg.$description: Large breakpoint compact legend typography for dense grouped controls such as filters, cards and settings panels.

color.$description: Default text colour for form legends.
Text colour for form helper text.
Text colour for inline form error messages.

background.$description: Background colour for form error surfaces, such as error summary or grouped error containers.

labelToHelper.$description: Vertical gap between a form label and helper text.

helperToError.$description: Vertical gap between helper text and an inline error message.

errorToControl.$description: Vertical gap between an inline error message and the control.

controlToNextField.$description: Vertical gap between one form field and the next.

betweenOptions.$description: Vertical gap between related options in grouped controls such as radios and checkboxes.

betweenFields.$description: Vertical gap between child fields inside a grouped form control.

background.$description: Default background colour for form controls.

foreground.$description: Default text colour for form controls.

color.$description: Default border colour for form controls.

width.$description: Default border width for form controls.

radius.$description: Default border radius for form controls.

block.$description: Default vertical padding for form controls.

inline.$description: Default horizontal padding for form controls.

ring.$description: Focus ring colour for form controls.

separator.$description: Separator colour between a form control and focus ring.

border.$description: Border colour for invalid form controls.

background.$description: Background colour for disabled form controls.

foreground.$description: Text colour for disabled form controls.

border.$description: Border colour for disabled form controls.

background.$description: Background colour for read-only form controls.

foreground.$description: Text colour for read-only form controls.

border.$description: Border colour for read-only form controls.

background.$description: Background colour for the error summary.

foreground.$description: Text colour for the error summary.

color.$description: Border colour for the error summary.

width.$description: Border width for the error summary.
